run_precompute_enumerate_surface: run the script to enumerate and pickle surface structures for a given bulk crystal index
create_enumerate_surfaces_for_saving: create a function that enumerates all symmetrically distinct surfaces of a bulk crystal structure up to a max Miller index
build_standardize_bulk: build a function that standardizes a bulk unit cell to its conventional standard structure using spacegroup analysis
test_is_structure_invertible: test whether a pymatgen Structure object is symmetric in the z-direction by checking its spacegroup symmetry operations
refactor_flip_struct: refactor a pymatgen Structure to flip it upside down by rotating 180 degrees around the x-axis and correcting cell vectors
